info.title: ReHealth tenant administration API
info.description: Read-only tenant-scoped patient aggregation for the website administration console.

get.description: Requires rehealth:admin:patient:view. Returns only active members of the authenticated operator's validated tenant who have a patient profile; institution employee accounts without a patient profile are excluded. Because profile and risk tables have no tenant column, users with another active tenant membership are excluded fail-closed. The list never calls Device Service, so every row has provenanceStatus=unknown; consumers MUST NOT include unknown rows in clinical risk statistics.

200.description: RehealthPatientPageVO in the standard Jeecg Result envelope

get.description: Requires rehealth:admin:patient:view. Verifies a patient profile and exclusive active target membership before one tenant-scoped Device Service read. A non-empty allow-listed real provenance set is verified_real and may expose non-Mock risk/RHI/RDI and latest intervention data. Synthetic provenance may expose risk, RHI/RDI, Factor16 and the latest intervention only when the corresponding records are explicitly Mock; consumers must label these values as test previews, exclude them from clinical statistics, and not present them as medical advice. Empty, mixed, unknown, or provenance/result mismatches stay fail-closed.

200.description: RehealthUserHealthVO in the standard Jeecg Result envelope

404.description: Patient is not an exclusive active member of the selected tenant

503.description: Software database, Device Service, or mounted internal credential unavailable

get.description: Disabled legacy route. Requires the same patient-view permission and returns code 410 without user data.

PatientSummary.description: PII-minimized patient view; phone, email and account username are never returned.

provenanceStatus.description: List rows are unknown. Detail is verified_real only for a non-empty allow-listed real source set, synthetic for explicit test sources, and unknown otherwise. Only verified_real non-Mock values may be counted as clinical risk.

factorContributions.description: Structured Factor16 explanation items stored with this risk result.

InterventionSummary.description: Read-only latest intervention summary. Synthetic provenance requires isMock=true and must be labeled as a test preview, not medical advice.
